title: Multi-Policy Discount on the RentGuard Renters Policy
content:
## Rating rule

1. The tier's multi-policy discount applies to every live RentGuard Renters Policy of a customer who also holds a live Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy or a live Larkspur Valuables Floater. Whether the customer holds one is judged across the customer's whole Larkspur portfolio by customer profile. A live policy is one that is bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal.
2. The discount is applied once however many qualifying policies are held, and it never stacks with itself.
3. A customer who holds a HomeGuard Homeowners Policy or a CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy does not qualify through it, because a renters policy never insures the same residence as one of those.
4. *Retired clause — no longer in force.* "When a qualifying policy is bound during the renters term the discount starts on that policy's effective date, and when the last qualifying policy ends during the term the discount stops on that policy's closed date; each is re-rated as a midterm change with change reason multi-policy discount change under the midterm change rules." This clause has been withdrawn and superseded by the current basis for a multi-policy discount that stops or restarts during the renters term.

The discount percentage is the tier's multi-policy discount percentage.

## Qualifying holdings at a glance

| Other Larkspur policy held under the same customer profile | Status | Counts for the multi-policy discount |
|---|---|---|
| Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy | bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal | yes |
| Larkspur Valuables Floater | bound, in force, pending cancellation or pending nonrenewal | yes |
| Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy or Larkspur Valuables Floater | cancelled or expired | no |
| HomeGuard Homeowners Policy or CondoGuard Unit-Owners Policy | any | no |

## Hypothetical cases

- A customer holds two live RentGuard policies and one in-force Larkspur Valuables Floater. The discount applies to both renters policies, once on each.
- A customer holds a live Larkspur Personal Umbrella Policy and a live Larkspur Valuables Floater. The renters policy carries the multi-policy discount once, not twice.

superseded_clauses: When a qualifying policy is bound during the renters term the discount starts on that policy's effective date, and when the last qualifying policy ends during the term the discount stops on that policy's closed date; each is re-rated as a midterm change with change_reason multi_policy_discount_change under renters_midterm_changes.
